hint.opengl: `glm::rotate(glm::mat4(1.0f), glm::radians(transform.eulerRot.x), glm::vec3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f))` for each axis, then `transformY * transformX * transformZ`; `glm::translate(glm::mat4(1.0f), transform.pos) * rotationMatrix * glm::scale(glm::mat4(1.0f), transform.scale)`. hint.d3d12: `XMMatrixRotationX(XMConvertToRadians(transform.eulerRot.x))` for each axis, then `transformZ * transformX * transformY` (learnopengl's Y · X · Z for column vectors); `XMMatrixScaling(…) * rotationMatrix * XMMatrixTranslation(…)`; `XMStoreFloat4x4(&transform.modelMatrix, getLocalModelMatrix(transform) * parentGlobalModelMatrix)`. In `PopulateCommandList`: `Transform planetTransform; computeModelMatrix(planetTransform, XMMatrixIdentity());` and `XMMatrixTranspose(XMLoadFloat4x4(&planetTransform.modelMatrix))` into the root constants.

hint.opengl: At the top of the frame: `setLocalRotation(ourEntity.transform, glm::vec3(0.0f, 20.0f * currentFrame, 0.0f)); updateSelfAndChild(ourEntity, glm::mat4(1.0f));` – only the root is dirty, so the update recomputes it and, through it, all its children.
